title: Launchers mark their sessions
body:
Outcome: every launcher sets one variable naming the session's class (delivery or non-delivery) and that it was started by automation; the inbox hook writes it to `source` and the SessionStart hook records it once.
Why: the inbox holds about one operator row in two (precision 0.48); every score of a text rule was in sample, where one overfit rule reached 1.00 and none was tested out of sample (`04` (k)). One probe prompt of this program reached the operator's inbox (`04` (g)), and so did the relay prompt that started its seventh session (row 312, 2026-11-10T08:32:50Z, no `source`).
Proof: a test starts a session through each launch path and sees `source` on the inbox row. After merge: a day of rows has no automation row without `source`, and a labelled sample of 30 rows is all correct.
Scope: `scripts/claude/successor-launch.ts` (both launch paths), `scripts/claude/operator-inbox.ts`, the SessionStart hook; `~/.claude/skills/context-relay/scripts/relay.sh` belongs to the operator.
Order: B1, B2, B3; then the two measurements B6 and B7; B4 when the operator adds the line; B5 last.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice B2.

Shipped: KRN_SESSION_CLASS (delivery|non-delivery) set by successor-launch.ts (Herdr tab env and --bg env; --class flag, probe passes non-delivery); the inbox writes it to source and open skips marked rows; the SessionStart hook records it once in .krn/operator/sessions.jsonl. Remains: after merge, a day of rows has no automation row without source and a labelled sample of 30 is correct; operator adds KRN_SESSION_CLASS=delivery to relay.sh (herdr agent start line, `env KRN_SESSION_CLASS=delivery herdr agent start ...`).
